messages.action_pilot: Pilot weather: speak the decoded METAR of your default airport
messages.action_airports: Airport weather: open your airports with their METAR and TAF
messages.placeholder_desc: the weather at your default airport, from the last report
messages.no_airport: No airport chosen yet. Add one in Preferences, Cockpit, or choose your city in Preferences, Weather, so Hariku can find the nearest.
messages.finding_nearest: Looking for the airport nearest to {city}...
messages.nearest_chosen: No favourite airports yet, so Hariku uses {name}, {code}, the nearest airport with a weather report to {city}.
messages.nearest_none: No airport with a weather report was found within about 300 kilometres of {city}. Add one in Preferences, Cockpit.
messages.err_offline: Could not reach the aviation weather service. Check your internet connection.
messages.err_service: The aviation weather service is not responding properly. Please try again later.
messages.err_rate_limited: The aviation weather service asked Hariku to slow down. Please try again in a few minutes.
messages.err_bad_response: The aviation weather service sent data Hariku could not read. Please try again later.
messages.report_old: This report is about {hours} hours old.
messages.cavok: ceiling and visibility OK (CAVOK): visibility 10 kilometres or more, no cloud below 5,000 feet and no significant weather
messages.qnh_inches: QNH {value} hectopascals, altimeter {inches} inches of mercury.
messages.cat_VFR: V F R, good visibility and a high cloud base
messages.cat_MVFR: marginal V F R, visibility or cloud base somewhat reduced
messages.cat_IFR: I F R, low clouds or poor visibility, instruments needed
messages.cat_LIFR: low I F R, very low clouds or very poor visibility
messages.taf_PROB_TEMPO: From {range}, a {percent} percent chance of temporarily {what}.
messages.taf_none: No forecast (TAF) for this airport right now.
messages.row_nearest_only: No favourite airports yet. Hariku uses {name}, nearest to {city}.
messages.list_empty: No airports yet. Add one with its ICAO code.
messages.up_to_date: Already up to date. Reports are fetched at most every 10 minutes.
messages.lbl_icao: ICAO code of the airport, 4 letters (for example WIDD for Batam or WIII for Jakarta):
messages.added_no_report: Added {name}, {code}. It has no recent weather report right now.
messages.err_not_icao: Type the airport's 4-letter ICAO code, for example WIDD.
messages.err_unknown_airport: {code} is not an airport with weather reports.
messages.err_too_many: You can keep up to {count} airports.
messages.auto_not_removable: Hariku chose this airport because it is nearest to {city}. Add your own airports to use them instead.
messages.nothing_selected: Select an airport in the list first.
messages.chk_captain: &Captain mode: aviation weather in the Morning Briefing and the evening summary, updated in the background every 30 minutes, and airport codes in the spelling alphabet
messages.note_captain: Turning Captain mode on offers to call you Captain and to set a cockpit greeting for when Hariku starts.
messages.lbl_favourites: Favourite airports (the first one is your default):
messages.lbl_add_code: ICAO code of an airport to add (press Enter to add):
messages.chk_briefing: Add airport weather to the Morning &Briefing (without Captain mode)
messages.attribution: Aviation weather: NOAA Aviation Weather Center (aviationweather.gov)
messages.disclaimer: For information only, not for flight planning.
messages.note_privacy: Hariku sends aviationweather.gov only airport codes, or a box around your Weather city to find the nearest airport, never your own location.
messages.offer_title: Shall Hariku call you {title}? Your greeting would then be, for example: {example}
messages.offer_greeting: Set a cockpit greeting for when Hariku starts? Hariku would say something like: {example}
messages.offer_clear_title: Captain mode is off. Remove the title {title}?
messages.offer_clear_greeting: Remove the cockpit greeting too, so Hariku greets you as usual?
messages.cockpit_greeting: Welcome aboard, %mytitle% %mynickname%. Welcome to your cockpit. It's %time% local, %zulu% Zulu. %airportweather%. You have %reminders%. What are we doing today?
messages.theme_installed: The Cockpit sound theme is installed. To use it, choose Cockpit in Preferences, Sound Themes, then press Use this theme.
messages.theme_no_extension: The Sound Themes extension isn't installed. Get it from the Cloud Store in Manage Extensions first, then press this button again.
messages.theme_disabled: The Sound Themes extension is turned off. Turn it on in Manage Extensions first, then press this button again.
messages.theme_failed: Hariku could not write the Cockpit sound theme.
